messages:
morgan: heads up — saw a console card show metrics from the org I just left after a rapid org switch. clicking refresh doesn't change it.

alex: is this in prod? can you share repro steps?

morgan: yes prod (region-us). repro: open org A -> open dashboard X -> quick-switch to org B via topbar. card still shows A's owner and metrics. happens intermittently.

sam: did you grab network/console logs? could be prefetch cache keyed incorrectly.

morgan: pasted snippet from server logs:```
2025-07-28T09:42:01Z INFO prefetch.cards user=uid-78 key=cards:prefetch:session:uid-78 org=null -> card[42]{org=A} served_from_cache=true
```

linda: org=null in the key is the red flag. adapter cache should include org_id + workspace. who touched the caching layer recently?

alex: PR #452 (fabian) simplified keys to `session_id` only to reduce churn, last month. might be the regression.

sam: that fits. quick-switch flow races: dropdown triggers switch before prefetch invalidation completes, so session-scoped cache can bleed previous org.

morgan: user-facing impact: brief cross-org metric/owner display. not full row-level leak (we still filter PII rows) but definitely leaks org attribution. customers noticed.

linda: seconds plan: 1) patch cache key -> include org_id, 2) canary deploy, 3) add rapid-switch e2e test, 4) add telemetry to measure occurrences.

alex: on it. I'll open a small patch to append `:${org_id}` to cache key and add unit test. also propose adding metric `console.card.cache_switch_mismatch` with prev_org/new_org.

sam: add tracing: set header `X-Render-Org` on render path so we can correlate logs to observed UI org.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary queued for eng-platform/cached-adapter-fix build#78 -> canary (region-us)

morgan: seen ~3 customer reports this morning. i'll monitor #incidents and ping legal if anything escalates.

linda: tests: unit for cache key composition, integration: script that does 50 rapid org switches and asserts card.org == current_org every render. also add assertion on cache lookup logs (org must never be null).

alex: ETA: PR in ~2h, canary in 30m after merge, observation window 1h. will post link.

sam: note: if we change keys to include org, we'll increase cache cardinality and backend calls on big org-switch churn. verify quota/ratelimiter: avoid thundering herd. maybe soft-throttle quick-switch events for a few seconds per session.

morgan: good call. we should also add a short client-side debounce (200ms) to reduce duplicate switches from rapid clicks.

linda: agreed. prioritize server fix first. alex — add a small telemetry metric for cache growth post-change so we can watch unit economics.

alex: will do. pinging @fabian for visibility.

morgan: thanks, team. keeping this thread updated as we roll. :thumbsup:
